decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. It corrects a confirmed exit-classification defect without changing steering or hazard behavior; do not claim faster laps, preserved completion, SOTA or submission readiness until an authorized controlled multi-track evaluation passes the stability-first gate.
implementation: Route only bare state-dict inference through _TranslationInvariantExitController; explicit export, DrQ and HAIC routes remain unchanged.

Recognize a clear aligned exit from every actually sampled center row30,34,38,42,46,50,54, measuring all row deviations relative to sampled near row54 rather than substituting IMAGE_CENTER for nonexistent rows.
Require shape sweep<=1.5, heading<=1.5, center offset<=6, inherited steering request<=0.28, no current obstacle and no active/frame-start latch.
On that gate only, use target68 and the existing straight gas branches0.18/0.135/0.09 plus the existing strict speed>69 brake boundary.
Preserve every steering value, true-curve action, obstacle action, active-latch action and latch-clearing-frame action exactly.

validation.independent_static_review: The initial review found a blocking omission of sampled near rows46/50. After the committed protocol amendment, implementation and a near-kink regression test included every sampled row; final review found no blocking defect.

temporary_package.result: exact-file package/import/reset/action smoke passed; this is not an official Linux, driving or submission evaluation

residual_risks: No authorized driving run measured whether earlier clear-exit acceleration preserves completion on unseen tracks.
The camera-row gate is an image-space alignment proxy and cannot measure physical edge clearance or tire force.
The videos contain no policy-camera, speed or pedal telemetry and include counterexamples, so they do not establish how frequently the new gate will activate.
SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md and report.pdf remain absent, and the competition website is inaccessible; official evaluation, promotion and submission remain blocked.
